# `representation` records

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from schemas/0.1/representation.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

One drawing of one or more functions on a page (ADR-0006, doc 03 §6, rank 33). An unplaced function has
no representation; panel fronts are derived, never stored.

Not in v0: `assembly_view` (assembly overviews, WP-S1.13).

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | `representation` |
| File | `pages/<page>.jsonl` |
| Rank | 33 |
| Status | implemented |
| Record version | 1 |
| Schema | [`representation.schema.json`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/schemas/0.1/representation.schema.json) |

## Types

### AnchorPolicy

Where a symbol's cross-reference anchor lies (FR-SYM-010).

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: The symbol origin (the default).

   Shape: `"origin"`

2. **Form 2**: The position of a text slot.

   Shape: object { `slot`: [`SlotKind`](#slotkind) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `slot` | [`SlotKind`](#slotkind) | yes |  | What a text slot prints (doc 07 §2.3). |

3. **Form 3**: The centre of the graphics.

   Shape: `"graphic_centre"`

4. **Form 4**: A named point.

   Shape: object { `named`: [`Pt2`](#pt2) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `named` | [`Pt2`](#pt2) | yes |  | A point [x, y] in nanometres, y downwards (doc 05 §3.2). |

### BoxSpec

The outline, CPs and inner graphics of a black box (doc 03 §6).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cps` | array of [`BoxCp`](#boxcp) | no |  | The box CPs. |
| `inner` | array of [`Primitive`](#primitive) | no |  | Graphics inside the box. |
| `outline` | array of [`Pt2`](#pt2) | yes |  | The outline polygon. |

### BoxCp

One CP of a black box: function CP index, position and direction.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dir` | [`Dir4`](#dir4) | yes |  | The direction a wire leaves the CP. |
| `idx` | integer (format `uint16`, min 0, max 65535) | yes |  | The function CP index. |
| `pos` | [`Pt2`](#pt2) | yes |  | Position relative to the representation. |

### Dir4

One of four directions on the sheet.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"up"` | Up (−y). |
| `"right"` | Right (+x). |
| `"down"` | Down (+y). |
| `"left"` | Left (−x). |

### Ident

An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text.

Type: string (at least 1 character(s))

Pattern: `^[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000](?:[^\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]*[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000])?$`

### Orient2

Orientation: rotation clockwise on the sheet, optionally mirrored (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: one of `"r0"`, `"r90"`, `"r180"`, `"r270"`, `"m0"`, `"m90"`, `"m180"`, `"m270"`

### PinMapEntry

One pin-map entry: symbol CP `symbol_cp` draws CP `idx` of `function`.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `function` | [`Uuid`](#uuid) | yes |  | The function. |
| `idx` | integer (format `uint16`, min 0, max 65535) | yes |  | The function's CP index. |
| `symbol_cp` | integer (format `uint16`, min 0, max 65535) | yes |  | The symbol's CP index. |

### Primitive

A graphic primitive in nanometres, relative to its owner's origin (doc 07 §2.3).

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: A straight line.

   Shape: object { `line`: [`LinePrim`](#lineprim) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `line` | [`LinePrim`](#lineprim) | yes |  | A straight line. |

2. **Form 2**: An open polyline.

   Shape: object { `polyline`: [`PolylinePrim`](#polylineprim) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `polyline` | [`PolylinePrim`](#polylineprim) | yes |  | An open polyline. |

3. **Form 3**: A rectangle with optional rounded corners and drop shadow.

   Shape: object { `rect`: [`RectPrim`](#rectprim) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `rect` | [`RectPrim`](#rectprim) | yes |  | A rectangle. |

4. **Form 4**: A circle.

   Shape: object { `circle`: [`CirclePrim`](#circleprim) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `circle` | [`CirclePrim`](#circleprim) | yes |  | A circle. |

5. **Form 5**: An ellipse in a bounding rectangle.

   Shape: object { `ellipse`: [`EllipsePrim`](#ellipseprim) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `ellipse` | [`EllipsePrim`](#ellipseprim) | yes |  | An ellipse. |

6. **Form 6**: An elliptic arc in a bounding rectangle.

   Shape: object { `arc`: [`ArcPrim`](#arcprim) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `arc` | [`ArcPrim`](#arcprim) | yes |  | An elliptic arc (QET's arc: bounding rectangle, start angle and sweep, counter-clockwise). |

7. **Form 7**: A polygon.

   Shape: object { `polygon`: [`PolygonPrim`](#polygonprim) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `polygon` | [`PolygonPrim`](#polygonprim) | yes |  | A polygon. |

8. **Form 8**: A text.

   Shape: object { `text`: [`TextPrim`](#textprim) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `text` | [`TextPrim`](#textprim) | yes |  | A text primitive. |

9. **Form 9**: An image asset.

   Shape: object { `image`: [`ImagePrim`](#imageprim) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `image` | [`ImagePrim`](#imageprim) | yes |  | An image asset placed in a rectangle. |

### SlotKind

What a text slot prints (doc 07 §2.3).

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: Device tag.

   Shape: `"tag"`

2. **Form 2**: Function text.

   Shape: `"function_text"`

3. **Form 3**: Technical data.

   Shape: `"tech_data"`

4. **Form 4**: Manufacturer.

   Shape: `"manufacturer"`

5. **Form 5**: Part number.

   Shape: `"part_number"`

6. **Form 6**: Type designation.

   Shape: `"type_designation"`

7. **Form 7**: Designation of CP `idx`.

   Shape: object { `cp_designation`: integer (format `uint16`, min 0, max 65535) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `cp_designation` | integer (format `uint16`, min 0, max 65535) | yes |  |  |

8. **Form 8**: Cross-reference.

   Shape: `"xref"`

9. **Form 9**: PLC address.

   Shape: `"plc_address"`

10. **Form 10**: Process tag.

   Shape: `"process_tag"`

11. **Form 11**: A user property.

   Shape: object { `user_prop`: [`Ident`](#ident) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `user_prop` | [`Ident`](#ident) | yes |  | An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text. |

12. **Form 12**: Contact image.

   Shape: `"contact_image"`

13. **Form 13**: The order code of the device's first assembly config (doc 10 §6 folio 3, doc 20 §11.1, D-36).

   Shape: `"order_code"`

14. **Form 14**: The station address of the drawn function's bus port, "Node TBD" or "Node 3" (doc 20 §11.1, FR-BUS-006; WP-S1.21 D11); empty for a port without an address.

   Shape: `"bus_address"`

15. **Form 15**: The termination of the drawn function's bus port, `Switch to "ON"` (FR-BUS-004; WP-S1.21 D11); empty for a port without a termination switch.

   Shape: `"bus_termination"`

### SlotOverride

An override of one text slot of the symbol (by index into `SymbolDef.text_slots`).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `angle` | [`Angle2`](#angle2) or `null` | no |  | Rotated text. |
| `pos` | [`Pt2`](#pt2) or `null` | no |  | Moved position, in symbol coordinates (before the representation's orientation is applied). |
| `slot` | integer (format `uint16`, min 0, max 65535) | yes |  | The slot index. |
| `visible` | boolean or `null` | no |  | Shown or hidden against the symbol's default. |

The import provenance of a record (doc 14 §2.3, ADR-0004 amendment 1): the lineage and the source key
from which the record's ID `v5(lineage namespace, key)` was derived.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | yes |  | The source key, byte for byte (NFC), such as `qet:el:<uuid>`. |
| `lineage` | [`Uuid`](#uuid) | yes |  | The import lineage. |

### Dash

A dash pattern scaled by the pen width (doc 07 §2.3).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"solid"` | Solid (the default). |
| `"dash42"` | Dash 4, gap 2 (× pen width). |
| `"dot12"` | Dot 1, gap 2. |
| `"dash_dot"` | Dash-dot. |

   Shape: `"p013"`

2. **Form 2**: 0.18 mm.

   Shape: `"p018"`

   Shape: `"p042"`

5. **Form 5**: 0.52 mm.

   Shape: `"p052"`

### MlText

Multilingual text: a neutral string, or an object keyed by canonical BCP 47 tags with non-empty string values (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express that all text is NFC or that the keys are in ascending byte order; the reader rejects both.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**

   Shape: string

2. **Form 2**

   Shape: map of string (at least 1 character(s)) (at least 1 propert(ies))

### Uuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`
